observations.footwork: Feet are planted at a comfortable stance width. Minimal lateral movement.
observations.guard: Both hands are engaged holding the red stick horizontally across the torso.
observations.upper_body: Torso is upright and relatively stationary.
observations.distance: Steady distance to the second person partially visible on the right edge.
observations.notable: The red stick remains held horizontally across the body.

observations.footwork: Lateral movement is visible; the fighter crouches slightly and shifts weight.
observations.guard: Red stick is angled upward while maintained in both hands.
observations.upper_body: Torso leans forward and down with the movement.
observations.distance: Distance to the second person appears open.
observations.notable: A step and crouch sequence with the stick angled upward.

observations.footwork: Footwork resets, moving back toward a more upright, stationary posture.
observations.guard: Red stick is angled downward and held with both hands.
observations.notable: The red stick swings downward through the sequence.

observations.footwork: A forward step is taken; the stance widens during the movement.
observations.guard: Red stick moves toward a horizontal angle and then shifts.
observations.upper_body: Torso bends forward as the step is completed.
observations.distance: Distance closes with the forward step.
observations.notable: Forward movement and bending of the torso at the end of the sequence.

movement_events.detail: Lateral step combined with a crouch and upward angle of the red stick.
Body resets to an upright position while the stick is angled downward.
Forward step with the torso bending forward and the stick shifting angle.
